views.front: The long media cabinet retains three separated ribbed fronts with softened top and side edges.
views.rear: Full-width rear and original small cable fitting remain intact.
views.detail: Door grooves and narrow pulls remain clear; the existing rib pattern is not a claim of realistic cane weaving.

views.clay: Three front panels and their relief survive the clay view; surface improvement remains restrained.
